theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.58%) and Financials (+0.52%) led the market today, while Communication Svcs (-0.89%) and Real Estate (-0.72%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.17%, defensives -0.07%, and value/cyclicals +0.17% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.59%, Dow +0.68%, Nasdaq +1.06% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.27%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX fell 3.64% to 16.68, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.13% to $4,141.10, crude oil was little changed at $97.96, and bitcoin gained 1.38% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
